Metadata.title: Horosphère — your daily ritual
Metadata.description: AI-personalized daily horoscope. A moment of calm and clarity, every day.

Footer.tagline: A daily ritual, built to last.

Home.heroImageAlt: An astrolabe on a balcony overlooking the sea, under a starry sky where the moon and planets trace their path at dusk.
Home.heroTitle: A moment of clarity, every day, without the pressure.
Home.heroSubtitle: Horosphère writes your daily reading from your sign — and soon from your full birth chart. Built to become a gentle habit.
Home.step1TextPromo: Create your account with just an email, no card required. 10 free credits (instead of 3) — valid for 7 days, September launch offer.
Home.step1Text: Create your account with just an email, no card required. You receive your first credits for free.
Home.step2Title: You read, at your own pace
Home.step2Text: Each reading uses a few credits. You only pay for what you use.
Home.step3Title: You stay, if it feels good
Home.step3Text: A pack when you need one, a subscription if Horosphère becomes a habit. Cancel anytime.
Home.ritualImageAlt: A quiet moment of writing by candlelight — Horosphère's daily ritual.
Home.ritualTitle: Two minutes, every morning, just for you
Home.ritualText1: No infinite scroll, no guilt-tripping notifications. Horosphère fits into a short reading, built to slot into your morning — a coffee, a moment of clarity, and you're off.
Home.ritualText2: The full birth chart goes further, for the days when you need perspective rather than a quick reading.
Home.packagesText: Credit packs with no rushed expiration (45 days to use them), or a subscription if Horosphère becomes a regular appointment. Nothing is forced on day one.
Home.freeAtLogin: Free at sign-up — no card required.
